guide.h2: Man and van service or a removal service?
p: A man and van suits small moves: a studio or one bed flat, a student room, or a few large items. For a family house move, a removals firm usually brings a bigger crew, a larger lorry, packing and better insurance. See removals in Leeds and our removals cost guide.

guide.h2: What to agree before the van arrives
ul: Hourly rate or fixed price, and whether travel time is charged
One person or two, and whether the driver helps carry
Stairs, lifts and how far the van can park from the door
Parking permits, especially in central Leeds and permit zones
Goods in transit insurance and what it covers
How you will pay, and whether a deposit is needed

p: June and September are the busiest months around Headingley, Hyde Park and Burley, when tenancies end and start. Book a man and van early for those weeks, and ask for a fixed price if you know exactly what is moving.

Some man and van services will also take unwanted items to the tip, but anyone who carries waste for money must be a registered waste carrier. If you mainly have rubbish, see rubbish removal in Leeds.

A man and van service in Leeds is usually priced on the time it takes to load, drive and unload, so having boxes packed and ready saves money. For moving locally within Leeds, a single van often does the job in a few hours. Many van services let you book online or by text with photos of what is moving. If you are moving a whole house across the UK, compare man and van hire with house removals companies, who bring more people and a bigger vehicle.

guide.h2: Man and van services across West Yorkshire
p: Most man and van firms in Leeds offer a range of van sizes, from a small van for a few boxes to a Luton van for home moves. A reliable man and van service is usually based in Leeds and covers West Yorkshire, including Horsforth, Headingley and Guiseley, and some will relocate you further across the UK. For a stress free move, get a quote in writing, read customer reviews and agree how loading and unloading will work. A good mover is quick and careful, and for a small flat a man and van can be a cheaper and more efficient service than full home removals.

faqs.q: How much is a man and van in Leeds?
faqs.a: Most charge by the hour, often with a minimum of one or two hours, and more for two people. Ask for the rate and any minimum when you book.

faqs.q: Is a man and van insured?
faqs.a: Many carry goods in transit insurance, but cover levels vary. Ask what is covered and the maximum payout before you book.

faqs.q: Will a man and van help carry?
faqs.a: Most will, but say if you need two people for heavy items or stairs. Some charge a lower rate if you do the carrying.

faqs.q: Can a man and van take rubbish?
faqs.a: Only if they are a registered waste carrier. Ask for the registration number, or use a rubbish removal firm.
